# A 233-acre parcel on Erie's eastern edge

The vicinity, land use, soils, and constraints that shape the design.
:::

## Vicinity

The project site is located in Erie, Colorado, draining ultimately to the Rural Canal.

*Vicinity map and site photos go here.*

## Existing conditions

Pre-development land cover is predominantly agricultural with scattered residential parcels. NRCS soils data classifies the area as Hydrologic Soil Group C.

## Proposed development

The post-development condition assumes mixed-use residential at typical Erie densities.

## Design constraints

::: {.callout-sage}
[Key constraint]{.eyebrow}
The Rural Canal outfall limits the allowable release rate to historic 2-year peak flow.
:::
